title: Quarterly initiative playbook: Hosted API + Model Catalog alignment (Q2 planning)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a repeatable quarterly playbook to align Hosted API roadmap work with the model catalog initiative and team OKRs. Deliverables: a prioritized initiative list for Q2, measurable success metrics (SLIs/SLOs + cost targets), a gating checklist for new model onboarding, and a rollout playbook that coordinates Console, Runtime, and Dedicated teams. This ticket drives the planning artifact and cross-team sign-offs needed for the next quarter.
comments: 2026-03-01 | Ava Martinez: Kickoff — scoped deliverables and invited stakeholders from Eng (runtime, infra), Design (console), and Research (evals). Added preliminary list of candidate initiatives: 1) model-variant gating policy, 2) catalog performance profiles, 3) prompt-eval baseline for regression alerts.

2026-03-03 | Liam Chen: First pass prioritization done. Marked top priorities: (A) Model gating criteria, (B) Per-model cost/latency profile in catalog, (C) Console rollout flow for canary/A-B. Proposed success metrics: 99th p50 latency per route, cost per 1k tokens < target, eval regression rate < 2% in canary.

2026-03-05 | Priya Desai (Eng): Trade-off note — strict gating (full eval + perf) adds ~2 weeks onboarding time for new models; suggested parallelize lightweight perf profiling to unblock catalog listing while full eval runs in background.

2026-03-07 | Marco Ruiz (Design): Console mockups uploaded to Confluence for a "Model Release" workflow; asks for a minimal MVP that surfaces per-model SLOs and a single-click rollback for canaries. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Model+Release+MVP

2026-03-09 | Research (Elena Park): Shared eval harness prototype and baseline dataset. Recommendation: require quality pass (top-3 metrics) OR observed human score > threshold for canary. Link to harness: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/eval-harness-Q2

2026-03-10 | Liam Chen: Alignment call notes — Eng will deliver a lightweight perf probe (latency/cost) by 2026-03-20. Research will run quick quality checks within 48 hours of model upload. PM to produce final OKR targets by 2026-03-14.

2026-03-12 | Security (Natasha Grove): Raised question about telemetry for private deployments — added as dependency: ensure telemetry export is opt-in and KMS-compatible. Marking security_review_required=true for the Model Release flow.

2026-03-13 | Ava Martinez: Draft OKRs posted: O1: Make model onboarding predictable — Key Results: average onboarding time <= 7 days, 90% of models have perf profile at listing. O2: Improve hosted API economics — KR: reduce average cost-per-1k-tokens by 12% through batching/caching improvements. Shared doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Q2+HostedAPI+OKRs

2026-03-14 | Liam Chen: Roadmap playbook v0 ready for review. Content includes: initiative prioritization matrix, gating checklist (quality, perf, security, telemetry), rollout recipe (canary windows, metrics to watch, rollback criteria), and required engineering milestones. Opening In Review with Eng/Design for sign-off. GitHub PR for the playbook artifact: https://github.com/redwood-inference/roadmaps/pull/198
